_comment: Copy to branches.json to change your branches. Each branch is a cylinder in the panel's engine. Add one and a cylinder appears. 'feeds' are RSS/Atom URLs, 'symbols' are Yahoo Finance tickers (optional), 'focus' steers the daily brief. Set enabled:false to park a branch without deleting it.

branches.name: Financial Markets
branches.focus: Where the major indices stand and what moved them. Lead with the levels, then the one or two stories that explain the day.

branches.name: Technology & AI
branches.focus: What actually shipped or changed - releases, launches, funding, notable research. Skip opinion pieces, reviews and rumour.

branches.name: World & Geopolitics
branches.focus: The developments that change something - conflict, elections, trade, energy. Say why each matters, not just that it happened.
